stem: Farhan finds $55\%$ of $40$ mentally using benchmark percentages.

options.text: The finished answer is the phrase "same whole", with no percent of $40$ computed.
Use the same benchmark story to compare lengths on an unrelated map scale.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Benchmark percentages of the same whole combine: $50\%$ of $40$ plus $5\%$ of $40$ gives $55\%$ of $40$.

teacher.key_rationale: $55\%=50\%+5\%$ of the same whole $40$ yields $20+2=22$. Naming "same whole" alone, mixing a different whole for $5\%$, or stretching to map scales are wrong.
